column1: # Endpoint ledger for the live contract suite (issue #126).
# calls must appear here exactly once. EndpointInventoryTests re-derives this set
# from the client sources on every run and fails if the two disagree — so adding
# an endpoint to the client without classifying it here is a build failure, which
# is the whole point: the repo can no longer drift away from its own API surface
#   read    - GET, exercised live every run: status + bearer auth + required fields
#   write   - exercised live, but only against throwaway objects this suite
#             creates and then deletes (never shared test infrastructure)
#   auth    - the sign-in call itself; exercised once per run
#   cleanup - exercised as the suite's own teardown (revokes OUR token, nothing else)
#   skip    - deliberately NOT exercised. The NOTE says why. These are not
#             "untested because we were lazy" — they are writes against shared
#             state, and running them would make this suite a liability.
